_meta.description: Golden and adversarial vectors for the Taproot envelope encoding (Part A) and default payload compression (Part B). Grammar bytes are frozen: any implementation must reproduce them exactly. Recognition expectations activate at the per-network §7 flag height; below it a decoder behaves exactly as shipped.
_meta.grammar: OP_FALSE OP_IF <"XCHN"> <format byte> <payload push 1..n, 520-byte elements> OP_ENDIF <internal x-only pubkey> OP_CHECKSIG
_meta.payload_definition: The reassembled payload (payload pushes concatenated, push framing excluded) is byte-identical to the compiled action stream the shipped lanes carry: the action-string push plus the rawData push, magic excluded (the envelope header carries it). The payload is RAW: never obfuscated (spec §3.3, pinned).

ceiling.name: ENVELOPE_MAX_PAYLOAD
ceiling.measures: reassembled payload byte length after concatenation, before parse; envelope push framing not counted; enforced identically in block and mempool paths

envelope_grammar.description: Golden grammar bytes for a single-push payload. envelope_script_hex is frozen.
envelope_grammar.raw_data_utf8: XChain taproot envelope golden vector payload

envelope_chunking.description: 1,246-byte compiled payload split into 520-byte pushes, in order; reassembly by concatenation is byte-identical.

chunk_rebalance.description: A payload whose length ≡ 1 (mod 520) with a final byte in the minimal-opcode range (0x01-0x10, 0x81) MUST be rebalanced: the final two pushes become (n-1, 2) bytes so no push canonicalizes to a bare opcode. Reassembly stays byte-identical.

source_attribution.description: Spec §3.4 (decision pinned by this vector once review lands): the reveal's ins[0] is the commit output, a payload-dependent one-time P2TR address, so naive ins[0]-prevout attribution breaks ownership/gating/fees.
source_attribution.rule: source = the address funding the commit, i.e. the prevout of the COMMIT transaction's ins[0], mirroring how the funding transaction anchors identity in the chunk lanes
source_attribution.build_time_task: read the shipped chunk-reveal attribution rule and keep the envelope structurally identical to it; if the shipped rule differs from this recommendation, the shipped rule wins and this vector is regenerated
source_attribution.requires: SIGHASH_ALL on all commit inputs (§3.5); commit-RBF replacements MUST preserve ins[0]

commit_fee_output_placement.description: Spec §3.5: native fee-destination outputs ride the COMMIT transaction, mirroring the funding transaction's role in the chunk lanes; the decoder's funding-fee resolver (findFundingFeeOutputs / FUNDING_VOUT_BASE) extends to the commit.
commit_fee_output_placement.commit_vout_0: the envelope P2TR output (by construction in the shipped encoder)
commit_fee_output_placement.fee_evaluation_height: the requirement in force at the REVEAL's block height, using the outputs recorded on the commit (build-time task: verify the shipped chunk-lane evaluation height and mirror it exactly)

deflate_raw_pair.description: Part B golden pair. Compression is presentational, never consensus: only INFLATION must be reproduced. deflated_hex is one valid encoding (Node zlib.deflateRawSync, default level), pinned for reader regression tests; encoders MAY produce different bytes for the same raw input.
deflate_raw_pair.compression_field: 1 (deflate-raw); empty/absent = raw; unknown values NEVER invalidate an action, readers degrade to serve-raw with a stored-form indicator
deflate_raw_pair.serve_guard: streaming decompression with a 150:1 ratio cap enforced as a streamed abort; fail-closed serving on any invalid stream

gated_compress_then_encrypt.description: Spec §5.4 ordering vector: deflate(plaintext) THEN AES-256-GCM (Token_Gated_Content layout: [12-byte nonce][16-byte tag][ciphertext]). The client inverts: decrypt, then inflate. Serve layers MUST NOT inflate ciphertext.
gated_compress_then_encrypt.compression_semantics: for gated FILEs COMPRESSION=1 means inflate-after-decrypt, client-side only

adversarial.name: bad_magic
adversarial.description: Same grammar, magic "XCHM": not an envelope. No action, no error, no RPC fetch.

adversarial.name: unknown_format_byte
adversarial.description: Format byte 0x01: unrecognized BY DESIGN (invisible, not invalid). Future formats activate via their own §7 flag heights.

adversarial.name: annex_bearing_reveal
adversarial.description: A reveal whose witness stack carries a BIP341 annex (last item leading 0x50) is NOT recognized as an envelope, forever (spec §3.8). Witness parsing MUST index from the END of the stack, annex-aware; fixed-index parsing misparses this.

adversarial.name: mixed_carrier_envelope_plus_op_return
adversarial.description: A tx containing an envelope reveal input AND an OP_RETURN XCHN payload is NOT a valid action (spec §3.8, height-gated: below the recognition flag height it replays exactly as the fleet indexed it, i.e. as the OP_RETURN action).

adversarial.name: mixed_carrier_envelope_plus_chunk_marker
adversarial.description: Envelope input plus P2SH/P2WSH chunk marker: no action post-flag.

adversarial.name: mixed_carrier_envelope_plus_multisign
adversarial.description: Envelope input plus MULTISIGN data outputs: no action post-flag.

adversarial.name: two_envelope_inputs
adversarial.description: A tx with two or more envelope reveal inputs is NOT a valid action (spec §3.8).

adversarial.name: over_ceiling_payload
adversarial.description: Reassembled payload length 400,001 > ENVELOPE_MAX_PAYLOAD: dropped (never truncated), deterministically, in BOTH the block and mempool paths.

adversarial.name: foreign_op_false_op_if
adversarial.description: Ord-style inscriptions and arbitrary OP_FALSE OP_IF trees without the XCHN magic + format byte: no crash, no false positive, no RPC fetch (recognition is free pattern-matching, spec §3.2).
